purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: Our breast cancer service wants a small table by hospital: how many women aged fifty through sixty-nine have a breast cancer diagnosis in the supplied history?
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Female sex; age 50 to 69 inclusive at the reference date.
Breast cancer means conditions.icd10 beginning C50.
Group by patients.data_holder, count distinct patients; metric: breast_cancer_women_50_69.
